purpose: Teach: 小田/富田/天野/遠山/篠原/藤村/須藤/牧野

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の小田部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome our newly appointed department head, Oda.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Crisp articulation on the directive. Calm baseline; this is standard protocol being stated. No inflection that suggests doubt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の富田課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate Sales Manager Tomita's travel schedule.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Efficient, slightly clipped—taking notes mentally. Professional readiness. No flourish, just competent forward motion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の天野主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the project to Amano, our lead technician.
lines.style: Clear directive, same steady authority. Weight on the assignment itself. Deliberate pace. Expects compliance without elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の遠山様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll adopt the PR strategy Toyama has proposed.
lines.style: Confirmation without hesitation. Slight lift of confirmation on 'understood'—showing he's tracking. Professional efficiency. Moving to the next item.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の篠原様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Consult with our advisor Shinohara for guidance.
lines.style: Directive with respect embedded in the tone. Slightly warmer than the first—deference to a senior consultant. Still authoritative but collaborative in feel.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の藤村様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the accounting close schedule with Fujimura.
lines.style: Quick, steady confirmation. Same efficient tempo. Demonstrating he's moving through the list methodically. No stumble, no delay.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の須藤様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Have our HR manager Sudo oversee the new employee training.
lines.style: Final directive of the sequence. Same measured authority. Slight completion-sense to the phrasing, but delivered with the same calm certainty as the rest.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の牧野様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request that Legal review the contracts with Makino.
lines.style: Final confirmation—slightly more weighted, as this closes the exchange. Professional closure. Alert and ready for follow-up if needed. Formal completeness.
